sources.name: USDA FoodData Central Foundation Foods
sources.removal_procedure: Remove affected food IDs, regenerate the catalog, run the release audit, and publish a new catalog version.
sources.update_procedure: Download the pinned official archive, verify its archive checksum, extract only reviewed IDs, review the source diff, then run import_nutrition_data.py.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy
sources.removal_procedure: Remove affected food IDs, regenerate the catalog, run the release audit, and publish a new catalog version.
sources.update_procedure: Re-download the final official SR Legacy archive, verify its archive checksum, extract only reviewed IDs, review the source diff, then run import_nutrition_data.py.
